title: How to Survive Kids’ Birthday parties – B2 English Listening Test

seo.title: How to Survive Kids' Birthday parties – B2 English Listening Test - Test-English
seo.description: English advanced listening test (CEFR B2). Transcription included. Watch a video about birthday parties and answer the questions.

parts:
B2 English Listening Test

Watch a video giving advice on how to survive children’s birthday parties. For every tip, 1 to 6, decide what it is about or what has been mentioned.

See the full list of B2 listening tests
Questions

choices.html: Make an effort to fulfil your children’s wishes
Children should be allowed to go to a fast food restaurant
Let your children know what you have planned
Tell your child how much you are going to spend
Try not to spend more than you can afford
Plan in advance what entertainment there will be at the party
Don’t feel obliged to invite all the people you child wants to invite
Talk to your child about the party to avoid disappointment
Talk to someone in case you may need their cooperation
Check the weather forecast if the party is outside
Take umbrellas or whatever necessary in case of rain
It’s better to make your own cake if you have time
Be careful about the ingredients in the cake
It’s not a good idea to tell parents whether they should stay or not
You should encourage parents to stay, if possible
Children prefer their parents to be there
